claims.text: The initial CoCrFeMnNi alloy is single-phase FCC.
The initial solutionized or as-cast microstructure lacks enhanced stacking-fault density.
The initial microstructure lacks pronounced short-range order.
A mild post-deformation heat treatment can selectively increase nanoscale stacking-fault density in CoCrFeMnNi.
The post-deformation heat treatment can induce short-range-order domains in CoCrFeMnNi.
The heat treatment can modify stacking faults and short-range order while minimizing changes in grain size and other structural features.
Nanoscale stacking faults and short-range-order domains act as barriers to dislocation motion.
Nanoscale stacking faults and short-range-order domains impede shear-band initiation and propagation during dynamic loading.
Impeding shear-band propagation disperses strain more uniformly and delays localization.
The modified microstructure improves ductility without reducing strength.
Heat-treated samples will have a higher strain-hardening exponent than untreated samples.
Heat-treated samples will exhibit a more uniform distribution of plastic deformation than untreated samples.
Heat-treated samples will exhibit lower shear-band density and intensity than untreated samples.
Heat-treated samples will show smoother dynamic stress-strain transitions with fewer serrations than untreated samples.
Untreated CoCrFeMnNi displays more localized shear banding under dynamic loading.
The proposed mechanism is expected to operate at room temperature and moderately high strain rates typical of impact testing.
Extreme temperatures or strain rates may activate additional deformation mechanisms.
Possible heat-treatment-induced changes in grain size or residual stress could confound attribution to stacking faults and short-range order.

contradictions.description: The intervention is described as a post-deformation heat treatment, but the controlled-comparison design does not specify the deformation step that must precede that treatment and instead presents treatment as occurring before the dynamic deformation test.
